page.content:
Cirra of Cintra was the daughter of Correl and Eschiva of Sodden and the sister of Ceran and Coram I. She married Radovid II and became queen of Redania and had two sons: Radovid III and Vizimir I.

page.overview:
Who is Cirra of Cintra?

Cirra of Cintra was the daughter of Correl and Eschiva of Sodden and the sister of Ceran and Coram I. She married Radovid II and became queen of Redania and had two sons: Radovid III and Vizimir I.
